purpose: Requirements for which Markdown files doc-link indexes (target specification, patterns, exclusions) and for issuing, verifying and resolving document IDs (DLIDs).
summary: Index target specification: ToC identification key plus a complete desired state given by the caller
Argument forms: --paths, --dirs, --exclude, --all, and --target-file written by doc-link
Pattern matching where ** matches zero or more directory levels
Fixed exclusions of directories such as .git and node_modules, and symlink handling
Documents leaving the index target and independence of document IDs from ToC keys
DLID format (DLID- prefix plus 12-character Crockford Base32) written to frontmatter doc_link_id
Validation of missing or duplicate document IDs and section IDs, and duplicate scope rules
DLID resolution to current path with recorded content hash, without modifying state
DLID assignment operation, the only writer of IDs, and the document ID confirmation stage
Acceptance criteria AC-005 to AC-031 for these requirements
tasks: Designing or implementing index target resolution and argument parsing
Implementing DLID assignment or embed-dlid behavior
Implementing DLID validation, duplicate detection and check-dlid
Writing tests for indexing targets and document ID acceptance criteria
Reviewing design documents against requirements for document IDs
title: doc-link 要件定義書 — Index 対象と[文書 ID]
